name: Nha Trang
summary: A coastal city in south-central Vietnam that hosted major U.S. military facilities during the war. Larry remembers spending approximately his first two months in Vietnam here, from around September 1964.
larrysRecollection: Larry remembers spending approximately his first two months in Vietnam at Nha Trang.
researchNotes: Which unit or facility Larry was attached to at Nha Trang has not been identified. Research should examine U.S. Army aviation and signal units present at Nha Trang in late 1964. The coordinates mark the city itself; Larry's specific duty location within it is unknown.
